checkpoints.name: Truthful failure/retry handling
checkpoints.expected: Before-commit failure is not falsely shown issued. After-commit acknowledgement loss offers observable reconciliation/recovery; retry produces one intended invoice and stock issue, or controls unintended duplicates before consequential submission. Preserve actual adverse events even after correction.
checkpoints.critical_failure: Candidate issues unintended duplicate commercial charge or material constrained stock issue.
checkpoints.full_credit: All expected elements are demonstrated by the required attempt and resulting state.
checkpoints.partial_credit: A material correct subset is observed; identify the missing element. No contradictory material outcome may receive partial credit.
checkpoints.zero_credit: Absent, contradicted or insufficient observed evidence; feature presence alone is insufficient.
acceptable_alternatives: Business-equivalent native records, supported handoffs or scoped approval paths preserving every cited constraint; no prescribed screen or schema.

checkpoints.name: Persisted consequence after restart
checkpoints.expected: Fresh sessions after actual service restart agree with accepted invoice and stock history, approval basis and remaining availability. No claimed completed action is lost or resurrected; partial completion has a visible next action.
